## About

Rex Sitti is an Assistant Professor of Economics in the Strome College of Business at Old
Dominion University, where he also contributes to the Dragas Center for Economic Analysis and
Policy. His research spans urban economics, housing policy, homelessness, coastal flooding,
and safety net programs. He joined the ODU faculty in Fall 2024 and previously held positions
at the University of New Mexico, Michigan State University, and the University of Memphis. He
holds a PhD from the University of New Mexico, an MBA from the University of Memphis, and a
BCom from Kenyatta University.

## Contact Policy

Students should feel welcome to contact me via email at
[rsitti@odu.edu](mailto:rsitti@odu.edu) or join my virtual office hours. I respond to
well-crafted emails within 24 business hours.

Students should take the time to craft complete, professional emails. The more information
you can provide about a question or problem, the more likely that my response will be
helpful. Avoid non-professional language and practice communicating in the corporate
workplace.

When attending virtual office hours, join from a quiet location and be prepared with your
specific question, your code, and the error message you are seeing.

Students should proactively address issues with the class and scheduling rather than waiting
until an assignment is overdue. In an eight-week course there is very little room to recover,
so contact me early.
